name: Office in Copilot
desc: Create and co-author real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files inside Copilot.
desc_zh: 在 Copilot 里直接创建和共同编辑真正的 Word、Excel 和 PowerPoint 文件。
solves: AI drafts live in one tool and the real document in another, and the two drift. Files made in Copilot inherit Microsoft 365 permissions and sensitivity labels from the start.
solves_zh: AI 草稿在一个工具里，正式文档在另一个里，两边越走越远。在 Copilot 里生成的文件从一开始就继承 Microsoft 365 的权限和敏感度标签。
best_for: You need a finished document or workbook, not text to paste into one.
best_for_zh: 你要的是一份能直接用的文档或工作簿，而不是待粘贴的文本。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Copilot Blog (Ignite 2026), https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilo）。 Announced 2026-09-25 as part of the new Copilot; general availability 2026-11-17. Distinct from Copilot inside the Office apps, which the ledger already covers as Microsoft 365 Copilot. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：在 Copilot 里生成并托管真实 Office 文件，属于智能体产出面，与 Copilot Cowork 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/11/17/copilot-at-microsoft-ignite-expanding-whats-possible-with-intelligence-built-for-work/
